    39          { NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL }
    40  };

    42  static int
    43  asn1_decode_des_params(sc_context_t *ctx, void **paramp,
    44                                  const u8 *buf, size_t buflen, int depth)
    45  {
    46          struct sc_asn1_entry asn1_des_iv[2];
    47          u8      iv[8];
    48          int     ivlen = 8, r;
    49
    50          sc_copy_asn1_entry(c_asn1_des_iv, asn1_des_iv);
    51          sc_format_asn1_entry(asn1_des_iv + 0, iv, &ivlen, 0);
    52          r = _sc_asn1_decode(ctx, asn1_des_iv, buf, buflen, NULL, NULL, 0, depth + 1);
    53          if (r < 0)
    54                  return r;
    55          if (ivlen != 8)
    56                  return SC_ERROR_INVALID_ASN1_OBJECT;
    57          *paramp = malloc(8);
    58          if (!*paramp)
    59                  return SC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
    60          memcpy(*paramp, iv, 8);
    61          return 0;
    62  }
    63
    64  static int
    65  asn1_encode_des_params(sc_context_t *ctx, void *params,
    66                                  u8 **buf, size_t *buflen, int depth)
    67  {
    68          struct sc_asn1_entry asn1_des_iv[2];
    69          int     ivlen = 8;
    70
    71          sc_copy_asn1_entry(c_asn1_des_iv, asn1_des_iv);
    72          sc_format_asn1_entry(asn1_des_iv + 0, params, &ivlen, 1);
    73          return _sc_asn1_encode(ctx, asn1_des_iv, buf, buflen, depth + 1);
    74  }

    78          { NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL }
    79  };

    83          { "hash_params", SC_ASN1_OBJECT, SC_ASN1_TAG_OBJECT, 0, NULL, NULL },
    84          { "cipher_params", SC_ASN1_OBJECT, SC_ASN1_TAG_OBJECT, SC_ASN1_OPTIONAL, NULL, NULL },
    85          { NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL }

    89  asn1_decode_gostr3410_params(sc_context_t *ctx, void **paramp,

    91  {
    92          struct sc_asn1_entry asn1_gostr3410_params0[2], asn1_gostr3410_params[4];

    94          int r;
    95
    96          sc_copy_asn1_entry(c_asn1_gostr3410_params0, asn1_gostr3410_params0);
    97          sc_copy_asn1_entry(c_asn1_gostr3410_params, asn1_gostr3410_params);
    98
    99          sc_format_asn1_entry(asn1_gostr3410_params0 + 0, asn1_gostr3410_params, NULL, 0);
   100          sc_format_asn1_entry(asn1_gostr3410_params + 0, &keyp, NULL, 0);
   101          sc_format_asn1_entry(asn1_gostr3410_params + 1, &hashp, NULL, 0);
   102          sc_format_asn1_entry(asn1_gostr3410_params + 2, &cipherp, NULL, 0);
   103
   104          r = _sc_asn1_decode(ctx, asn1_gostr3410_params0, buf, buflen, NULL, NULL, 0, depth + 1);
   105          /* TODO: store in paramp */
   106          (void)paramp; /* no warning */
   107          return r;
   108  }

   112                  u8 **buf, size_t *buflen, int depth)
   113  {

   115          struct sc_pkcs15_gost_parameters *gost_params = (struct sc_pkcs15_gost_parameters *)params;

   119          sc_copy_asn1_entry(c_asn1_gostr3410_params, asn1_gostr3410_params);
